en:
Well, look at that! You voted correctly!
Congratulations, you guys!

Give yourselves a hand!
Let me hear your joyful voices!
*sob* *sob*
I said, let me hear your joyful voices!
Dammit...why!?

Geez, they're all just moping around!
They should be happy for themselves!

I know I'm super happy!
Hey, what should we name the kid?

Good question.
We should prepare...six names.

What!? We're having sextuplets!?
I'm so happy I might go crazy!

Hey, Kokichi... You said this would liven
things up. What gives, huh?

You said you were gonna liven up the killing
game and the class trial...

And I said I'd put the motive—<CLT=cltSTRONG>the secret of the
outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>—into the killing game simulator.
Ah-haha, that was juuust a lie.
Oh, so it was just a lie.
He just laughed it off!?

Are you satisfied, Kokichi?
I want you to tell us.

What is the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>"?
Is it the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> you gave Gonta?

I plan to explain all of that...
but it's more like, how do I say it...?

You guys are just gonna assume it's a lie
if you hear it from my cute lips...

Oh, yeah!
Then let's have Gonta explain!
...Huh? Gonta?

Gonta doesn't remember anything; how can
you expect him to—

Then, we should all go back into the killing
game simulator!
What?

Why don't we ask the Gonta in 
the Virtual World?
B-But...going back to the Virtual World is—

Puhuhu... There's a much easier way than
that pain-in-the-ass method.

Gonta's memories didn't transfer over, so
they're still in the Virtual World as data...

I can combine Gonta's consciousness from his
last log-in with that leftover memory data!
Ta-da! <CLT=cltSTRONG>Alter Ego Gonta<CLT=cltNORMAL> is now complete!
...Alter Ego?

Basically, it's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>separate Gonta<CLT=cltNORMAL> that
only exists in virtual space.

If we listen to what he says, we should be able
to find out what happened in that world.
Huh? What this? What happening?
Is this...Gonta?
Is that...Gonta?

W-What sort of phenomenon is this?
What did you do?

Relax, Himiko. It's not magic and it's not
a trick.

Alter Ego Gonta is just a computer
simulation.

It's just imitating Gonta's thought patterns.
It's actually different from the real Gonta...

G-Gonta not understand...
Who this "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Alter Ego<CLT=cltNORMAL>" person?

See? It's even stupid like the real Gonta!
You can hardly tell the difference!

Plus, he's got Gonta's memories of the Virtual
World, so he should remember what happened.
Th-Then, other Gonta...tell Gonta.
Why!? Why did Gonta kill Miu!?

Kill Miu...? Why does other Gonta know
about—

Unfortunately, our plan failed. 
You can tell them the truth now...
Then...Gonta no could save everyone?
...Save everyone?

Hey! Answer Gonta!
Why did Gonta kill Miu!?
Gonta just...want to...save everyone.
<CLT=cltMIND>He wanted to save everyone...?
Gonta...what do you mean?

Gonta think for long time... How can Gonta
be useful for everyone?

Gonta not smart enough to help with trials...
Gonta strong, but no can fight Exisals...

Gonta feel frustrated...cuz Gonta no could do
anything.
Gonta understand...how this Gonta feels.
Technically, they are the same person.

So that's why...Gonta think he have to do
<CLT=cltSTRONG>it<CLT=cltNORMAL>, for everyone's sake.

Gonta think he gotta do it, cuz everyone
else not want to.
So...Gonta kill Miu.

What do you mean by that?
I... I don't get it at all!

...Geez, Gonta is bad at explaining as always.
I guess I'll have to help.

So, if you remember what happened
at that time.

No, we shouldn't. If we want to prevent
another murder from happening—
Yoink! I'll take that card key then!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi used his lithe body to his advantage
and took the card key from Monokuma.

The card key...
So you used it?

After working tirelessly, I finally found the
door for the card key. After opening it...
...I saw the <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...The outside world?
That was Monokuma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

But why would seeing the outside
world be a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

I'll tell you guys in a second, but...
that was when I found out about Miu's plan.

And it hit me... If I combined the two,
then I'd be able to save everyone.
Save everyone...? What do you mean?

Hey now, you gotta listen to everything
I say first.

Anyway, that's when I made a deal with
Monokuma. If I livened up the killing game...

...then he would let me use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside 
world<CLT=cltNORMAL> as a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> again.
Again...?
Lemme chime in!

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive key card<CLT=cltNORMAL> that Kokichi nabbed was
<CLT=cltSTRONG>the right to view the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But even though he saw the outside world,
he didn't try to use it for the killing game...

That disappointed me, but then Kokichi
suggested that we reuse the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

He said we should bring back <CLT=cltSTRONG>the right to
view the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> one more time.
And I decided to run with that idea...

So I loaded a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> with <CLT=cltSTRONG>memories of
the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> and put it in the simulation.

Memories of the outside world...
in the Flashback Light?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the Virtual
World was about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
And, if it was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

it would mean the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside
world<CLT=cltNORMAL> is part of our forgotten memories.
What are you saying...?

But why would anything about the outside 
world be a <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the first place?
What's...going on here?

Huuuh, you can't remember?
O-kay, fiiine.

Let's talk about the motive later.
We have to finish up this case first.

Monokuma hid the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the 
simulator, but I knew where it was hidden...

...and I showed it to Gonta in the
Virtual World.

Hey! You even knew where it was
hidden!? That's not fair!

Whoa, I just placed it.
I never actually said I "hid" it.

If anyone had asked, I would've gladly
told you where it was.
I-It's a little late for that!

So Gonta was exposed to the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Yeah, when Kokichi and Gonta leave together...

Was Kokichi...trying to lure Gonta
off by himself?

The only person I entrusted with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of
the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> was Gonta.

After that, Gonta...got taken to forest near
mansion.

And there...Gonta remember <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of
outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

But that...just confuse Gonta more
about what to do...

What can Gonta do to save everyone...?
Gonta no could think of anything...
So I told him.

If he wants to save everyone, he should
put everyone out of their misery.
In other words...a mercy kill.
Wh-What!?
Was Gonta...tricked!?
No, you not tricked.

Cuz, when Gonta remember <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret
of outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Gonta think...
...it would be easier...to die.
...What?

Remember what everyone said at the
beginning? That this academy is hell?
Gonta...agree.

Academy that force students to be part of
killing game is hell.

So everyone think they wanna escape this
place, right?
But...if it's still hell outside, what do we do?
What do you mean, Gonta?

Inside is hell! Outside is hell! What should
Gonta and friends live for!?

And everyone who died...
What did they die for!?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's hell outside...and hell inside...
And then, Kokichi tell me...

Best way to save everyone from hell, is to put
them out of misery while they still not know.

And only one who could do such dirty work...
is Gonta.

That's right... The only way you can save
everyone is to free them from this hell.
Gonta took on the dirty work for us.

If he had survived the class trial,
he would've lived in this hell alone...

Gonta took on that role for us!
Shouldn't we appreciate him more!?

Wait a minute!
I still don't get what's happening!

What <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> are you talking
about? It's hell out there? What do you mean?

What did Kokichi and Gonta see?
What did...we forget...?

Hurry up and tell us. Or else we won't
be able to understand it.

Gonta, what pushed you to
do such a thing!?
Answer, Gonta!
Sorry! Gonta no can tell you!
Can't tell us!? Why!?

B-Because...if Gonta tell you, then...
everyone will end up like Gonta...
Everyone...despair.
Despair!?

I...know it...
A despair that makes you want to die...

A despair that makes you want to put 
everyone out of their misery...

Did you think the kind Gonta would tell you
about such despair from his own mouth?

But now we don't know any
more than when we started...

Now you know how Gonta and I formed the
Killing Game Busters, right?

Then...can't you accept everything about
this case? You can imagine the rest, right?

I...used Miu's plan and turned 
it against her...

I hid Gonta away from sight...
where Miu and I were supposed to meet.

I-It can't be...
Gonta...would never...

You should know that it was Gonta's idea
to slide the body to the chapel wall.
What? Gonta's idea?

Before Gonta went to the roof, he happened
to see...
...Miu walk through the wall.

Gonta tell Kokichi, and he think of everything
else...

Gonta gave me that chance.
I like to think...we make a pretty good team.

Good!? What's good about that!?
You're the worst!

...That's whole story.
That's...everything that happen.

So in the end...you don't plan to tell us 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
Sorry! Gonta no can tell you that!

Well, I mean, hearing that story, it 
sounds like you were tricked by Kokichi.

But...Gonta did kill Miu...
Gonta really did it...
Sorry! Everyone...Gonta is so sorry!
G-Gonta!
But...Gonta's plan to save everyone fail...

Gonta not save anyone...
Gonta just make everyone suffer more...

Gonta...is stupid! So stupid!
How can Gonta call himself gentleman!?
Everyone...please forgive him.

Gonta tried to save us all from despair
by taking on the sin of killing us.

But...you reached for the truth.
And Gonta's plan failed.

All of you could've been saved if you
died without knowing anything...

So you're saying it was wrong to
fight for the truth!?

Yes, it was.
At least, Gonta and I think so.
You should have all died ignorant...
Gonta even killed Miu for that sake, y'know?

Enough of your shit!
You made him kill her!
No! Gonta is bad!

Cuz Gonta kill someone!
Gonta is murderer! It's true!

Yes...Gonta make everyone suffer.
That is true...
Sorry! Gonta is sorry he fail everyone...

Gonta is sorry for being stupid! Gonta is sorry
he make everyone suffer! Gonta so sorry!

W-We get it... You don't need...
to apologize anymore...

You're probably all thinking that I should've
taken on the dirty work and not Gonta, right?

Everyone...hates me...
so the role of villain is perfect for me...

Yeah, I know already!
It should've been my responsibility!

But...when I realized Miu was targeting me...
I thought to myself...

...she must already have a way to prevent 
me from fighting back in the Virtual World.

And in fact, you were right. She set it up so
she could paralyze you with just a touch.

That's why I had to ask Gonta!
I would've done it myself if I could!

Okay, but... You didn't need to
push everything onto Gonta to-
Stop! It's okay!

Everyone, please...
Don't...blame Kokichi anymore...
Please...
Gonta...you...!

H-How nice can you be, Gonta?
You really are...stupid sometimes...

Y-You're right... Someone as stupid as
Gonta could never be a gentleman—
Hey, so...are we done yet?
...What?

You guys are starting to talk in circles, so
let's just move on to the exciting stuff.
Yes! The eagerly anticipated Punishment Time!

Wait! If you're gonna punish him,
then please...punish me too.
Kokichi...?

I'm prepared for it!
If you're gonna execute Gonta, then I—

It's okay, Kokichi. Please let Gonta sacrifice
himself...for everyone's sake.
That's all...Gonta can do anymore...

Just promise Gonta...that everyone forgive
each other and be friends. Okay?
...Alright, I promise.

Alright! It's time to punish the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Entomologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Gonta Gokuhara—

Oh, man... I bet his punishment's gonna have
a lot of gross, nasty bugs.
Ugh...gh...!
That's right! You don't like nasty stuff!
N-No...it's not that...
I-It's...coming...
What!? Already!?

The contractions...are speeding up...
A-Any minute now...
Quick, hold my hand!
I've prepared a special punishment for him!
U-Ugh...!

W-Wait, please! I don't want this!
Don't go, Gonta!

Don't cry, Kokichi...
Gonta...is okay...

Yeah...Gonta not cry...
Gonta's...really not scared...
B-But...

Gonta upset! Gonta upset...he no could
protect everyone!

Gonta, you...!
You...can't cry either!

Well then, let's give it everything we've got!
It's...PUNISHMENT TIIIME!
Gonta love you all...!
Gonta is so sorry...for being stupid!
